title: Chocolate fondue in bed? Yes please 🍫
description:
The cosiest way to spend December 25 under the duvet.

The white Meltie Mini Fondue Mug on a breakfast-in-bed tray: malt balls in, tealight lit, waffles and marshmallows dipped and dripping. A mini chocolate fondue in one mug for movie nights, cosy evenings and gifts.

Get the Meltie Mini Fondue Mug: https://meltiemug.com/products/mini-fondue-mug
